name: News Hero Carousel
description: Full-screen auto-advancing news hero where image slides rise in with a tag, headline and link, plus glass preview tabs with a progress bar on desktop and a top progress bar on mobile.
contents: Full-bleed slides with background image, tag badge, headline and link or play-video call to action
Glass tab cards on desktop showing tag, date and title for each slide
behavior: Auto-advances on a timer with a progress bar filling per slide
Slides transition by sliding up with fade, text staggers in
Clicking a tab jumps to that slide and resets progress
Tabs are hidden below 1024px where a thin top progress bar shows instead
editableByProps: Slides: tag, date, headline, image, link text, link URL, link or video type
Accent, overlay, background and text colors, timing, and text alignment

needsCodeEdit.where: hidden lg:grid tab container at the end of the root

fixed: Slides use a fixed 100 step progress timer and a 500ms click lock
Root is min-h-screen and full-bleed; slides are absolutely positioned
